calc.assessment: Purchase assessment: On target if stock was low at purchase or the item was proven used; Needs review if stock was still available at purchase & nothing issued since; Too early if stock at purchase > 6 months of demand (requires ≥ 90 days of prior data); Unused if not issued at all for ≥ 90 days.
calc.dead: Dead stock = stock > 0 not issued for 12 months. Overstock = stock above 12 months of demand, valued at the latest price.
calc.held: Capital tied up = purchases − usage: spend that has become inventory on the racks.
calc.purchases: Purchases = value of the ERP Receipt sheet. Usage = Issue sheet (STK-MTL) minus returns; kiosk scans are counted after the latest ERP data date to avoid double counting.
calc.scope: Stock value covers only the M03 warehouse (Maintenance Store); machines & production assets in the ERP master are excluded.
calc.variance: Count variance = (opening stock + purchases − usage) − physical stock in the next snapshot.
import.adj: ADJ-CST (value adjustments) & the same file on the same stock date are not recorded twice.
import.issue: Issue STK-MTL → usage per PM Job; MTL-STK → returns (reduce cost); bin transfers & duplicate receipts are skipped.
import.master: Stock master → stock snapshot per date; current stock & prices are only updated by the newest file.
import.newpart: Parts missing from the master are created automatically (name, bin & price from transactions). Their stock = in − used after the latest stock date; old parts no longer present = 0.
≥ 90 days since purchase and never issue: ≥ 90 days since purchase with no issuance — idle inventory.
